readings.summary: Make the collector’s metadata-symbol diagnostic paths null-safe so generating the closed generic struct’s formatter information completes normally, without changing collection behavior for source-declared or reference types.
readings.code_difference: Replace the unguarded DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] accesses in GetObjectInfo with FirstOrDefault-style handling and a safe fallback when no location exists, while leaving CollectGeneric’s call to GetObjectInfo in place; add the two-project repro to verify both generator and analyzer complete and app receives GeneratedMessagePackResolver, plus regressions for the table’s already-working cases.
